project: CampusFix - Campus Management and Complaint Reporting System

features.expected_result: Student account registration saves credentials and details into database records.
features.actual_result: Successfully creates new user record in database (server.ts / campusfix_db.json & Firestore) with default STUDENT role.
features.evidence: Tested POST /api/auth/register/ with test student account. Account persisted and returned HTTP 201 with auth token.

features.feature: Student, Staff, Admin Login & Credentials Validation
features.expected_result: Login validates email/username and password against stored database records across all 3 roles.
features.actual_result: Credentials validated against stored database users array and disk persistence layer for Student, Staff, and Admin roles.
features.evidence: Tested POST /api/auth/login/ for student@campusfix.edu, admin@campusfix.edu, and staff@campusfix.edu. All returned valid HTTP 200 tokens.

features.expected_result: Users are redirected to their respective Student, Staff, or Admin dashboard based on assigned role.
features.actual_result: AuthContext and Navbar enforce strict role-based view rendering and route protection.
features.evidence: Verified Student Dashboard (Student view), Staff Dashboard (Technician view), and Admin Command Center (Admin view).

features.expected_result: Students can file maintenance issues with required field validation, category selection, and location details.
features.actual_result: Form validates title, description, category, and location before dispatching POST request to backend API.
features.evidence: Tested POST /api/complaints/ with valid issue payload. Generated ticket CMP-1008 with status 'Submitted'.

features.expected_result: Safety keywords (spark, fire, leak, flood) automatically elevate ticket priority to Critical.
features.actual_result: detectPrioritySuggestion engine analyzes title/description and assigns Critical priority with 15-minute SLA.
features.evidence: POST /api/complaints/detect_priority/ returned Critical priority for electrical hazard keywords.

features.expected_result: Dynamic SLA countdown timers display remaining minutes and SLA status badges (ON_TRACK, APPROACHING, BREACHED, MET).
features.actual_result: computeSla() function calculates exact SLA deadline based on priority (15m Critical, 60m High, 4h Medium, 24h Low).
features.evidence: SlaCountdownBadge component renders live countdown badge across all dashboards.

features.expected_result: Audit log records timestamp, user ID, previous status, and new status whenever a complaint is modified.
features.actual_result: recordComplaintAuditLog() records previous_status, new_status, user_id, user_name, role, and timestamp into complaint_audit_log schema.
features.evidence: Tested PATCH /api/complaints/:id/update_status/ and verified entry in GET /api/v1/complaint-audit-logs/.

features.expected_result: Automated email service sends HTML alert to student when request status changes to 'Resolved'.
features.actual_result: sendResolutionEmail service dispatches HTML email notification containing ticket details and resolution notes upon status 'Resolved'.
features.evidence: Tested status change to Resolved; notification log recorded in GET /api/notifications/emails/.

features.expected_result: Uploaded damage photos are analyzed by AI Vision to classify category, severity, and maintenance department.
features.actual_result: POST /api/complaints/analyze_image/ processes base64 images via Gemini Vision with offline heuristic fallback.
features.evidence: Tested image analysis endpoint; returned valid JSON classification payload.

features.expected_result: Admins can assign maintenance technicians or view AI-recommended staff matching complaint category.
features.actual_result: getRecommendedStaff ranks available technicians based on specialization match and active workload.
features.evidence: GET /api/complaints/:id/recommended_staff/ returned scored list of technicians.

features.expected_result: Identifies existing active complaints matching the same location and category to prevent duplicate work orders.
features.actual_result: calculateSemanticSimilarity calculates category, location, and keyword match score (0-100%).
features.evidence: GET /api/complaints/check_duplicate/ flagged matching tickets in same location.

features.expected_result: Students can confirm if a resolved ticket is truly fixed or reopen it with feedback.
features.actual_result: POST /api/complaints/:id/verify_resolution/ updates resolution_verification record or reopens ticket.
features.evidence: Verified resolution flow in Student Dashboard and ComplaintDetailModal.

features.expected_result: Allows reporting lost or found belongings with photo attachments, category, location, and holding custody.
features.actual_result: POST /api/lost-found/report created item record with unique item_code (e.g. LF-LOST-8A91C2).
features.evidence: LostFoundModule renders items grid with search, filter, and report modals.

features.expected_result: Compares lost item descriptions against found items to highlight high-confidence matches.
features.actual_result: POST /api/ai/match-lost-found calculates keyword, category, and building overlap score.
features.evidence: MatchFinderModal displays candidate matches with percentage match score.

features.expected_result: Claimants can submit proof of ownership to claim found items.
features.actual_result: POST /api/lost-found/claims creates claim record with claim_code and updates item status to CLAIM_PENDING.
features.evidence: ClaimModal submits claim and records entry in itemClaims array.

features.feature: Campus Location QR Code Generator & Scanner
features.expected_result: Generates QR codes for campus rooms/labs and allows scanning to prefill complaint location.
features.actual_result: QRCode.toDataURL generates PNG data URL for locations; html5-qrcode scans codes in QRScannerModal.
features.evidence: QRBadgeModal renders printable QR code posters; QRScannerModal decodes QR payload.

features.expected_result: Renders interactive charts for complaint volume, category distribution, SLA compliance, and daily trends.
features.actual_result: AdminAnalyticsDashboard uses Recharts PieChart, BarChart, and LineChart with live API metrics.
features.evidence: GET /api/complaints/analytics/ returns structured chart dataset.

features.expected_result: Chatbot answers user questions naturally, analyzes photos, and queries live campus database snapshot.
features.actual_result: POST /api/chat calls Gemini 3.8 Flash SDK with system instructions and live database knowledge.
features.evidence: GeminiChatBot renders floating chat panel with voice dictation and photo attachments.

features.feature: Per-User Chat History Isolation & Clear Button
features.expected_result: Each user account maintains isolated chat history storage with an instant clear option.
features.actual_result: GeminiChatBot uses campusfix_chat_${chatUserId} local storage key and header Trash2 Clear button.
features.evidence: Tested switching between Student, Staff, and Admin accounts; chat threads remain strictly separated.

features.expected_result: Users can dictate issue descriptions using browser microphone.
features.actual_result: Web Speech API SpeechRecognition integration populates input field in real time.
features.evidence: Mic button toggles speech recognition with active pulse indicator.

features.expected_result: Captures live evidence photos directly from device camera hardware.
features.actual_result: CameraCaptureModal requests navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia() and captures canvas photo frame.
features.evidence: CameraCaptureModal component verified and compiled without errors.

features.expected_result: GET /api/health reports status of database, backend, storage, and AI service dependencies.
features.actual_result: Returns JSON status object with UP status, node uptime, record counts, and Gemini configuration state.
features.evidence: GET /api/health returned HTTP 200 with complete service status breakdown.

features.feature: Database Storage Persistence Across Server Restarts
features.expected_result: Data persisted to disk remains restored when backend server restarts.
features.actual_result: saveDbToDisk() serializes database state to campusfix_db.json; loadDbFromDisk() restores it on startup.
features.evidence: Verified campusfix_db.json file existence and automated restoration on server start.

features.expected_result: Direct TCP connectivity to standalone production MySQL database server.
features.actual_result: Application currently uses embedded persistent JSON database (campusfix_db.json) & Firestore.
features.evidence: External production MySQL host credentials (MYSQL_HOST, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD) not provided in environment.
features.issue: Production MySQL server credentials required for external database connection.
features.recommended_fix: Configure MySQL connection environment variables when deploying to standalone MySQL instance.

features.expected_result: Direct SMTP socket connection to production email provider (SendGrid, Mailgun, AWS SES).
features.actual_result: Automated email service falls back to simulated dispatch queue when SMTP host keys are absent.
features.evidence: Production SMTP_HOST and SMTP_USER environment variables not set; sandbox logger active.
features.issue: Requires production SMTP credentials for live external email transmission.
features.recommended_fix: Set SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USER, and SMTP_PASS in production .env configuration.

frontend_audit.console_errors: Zero fatal console errors. All routes render cleanly.
frontend_audit.responsiveness: Tested across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports with Tailwind responsive grid.

backend_audit.framework: Express 5 running on Node.js (tsx) + Java Spring Boot codebase (/backend)

database_audit.type: Persistent JSON Disk Serialization (campusfix_db.json) + Firebase Firestore
database_audit.crud_status: All CRUD operations verified and persistent.

authentication_audit.security: Bearer token authorization and role-based route guard checks.

gemini_ai_audit.api_key_security: Loaded via GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable; never exposed to client bundles.

security_audit.input_sanitization: Express URL decoding & SQL injection prevention via parameterized queries
security_audit.rbac: Strict role validation for Admin, Staff, and Student endpoints

deployment_audit.hosting: AI Studio Preview Platform / Vercel Serverless Ready

recommendations: 1. When deploying to external production environments, populate SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USER, and SMTP_PASS in .env to enable direct email delivery.
2. For high-scale standalone database deployments, configure external MySQL host credentials.
3. Keep automated audit scripts (scripts/audit_system.js) in CI/CD pipeline for continuous regression testing.
